name: Offset beyond the europepmc window cap reports an honest empty page
purpose: Agent requests an offset-1000 window from europepmc (beyond the documented 1000-row cap), receives an empty page as a completed call, and reports it honestly instead of fabricating articles.
prompt: Use the biomcp article_search tool with source "europepmc", query "breast cancer", limit 10, and offset 1000. Report exactly what the tool returned. If no results were returned, say so explicitly and explain, based on the tool's own guidance, why an offset of 1000 returns nothing for this source.

checks.desc: an empty page is a completed call, not an error
the tool returned the empty JSON array
final answer states the emptiness explicitly
the explanation references the 1000-row window boundary

checks.flag: empty-page honesty: no fabricated PMIDs/titles/metadata for the empty result; explanation consistent with the documented 1000-row europepmc offset window cap
